cluster_thesis.text: Not one cycle but two, rolling from one generation into the next. HBM3 is flat at $9.00/GB (0.0% within stack-derived basis, 07-19 to 09-15) and HBM4 prints $16.00/GB contract, a ~29% per-GB premium over HBM3E's $12.40 on the same date and same basis. The cluster tailwind is intact but it has MIGRATED generations: exposure to HBM as a category no longer describes exposure to where memory margin is being made. This is why the desk's single `late` cycle read is too coarse for this cluster -- HBM3/HBM3E is late, the HBM4 ramp is early, and they are opposite trades inside one sleeve.
cluster_thesis.falsifier: MU's 2026-10-01 FQ4 guiding HBM4 committed capacity flat or down, or a second tier-1 HBM4 contract quote below $13/GB, would collapse the generational premium and make this a single late-cycle bet rather than a rolling one.
